Slide Variant

Light (Default)

  • White background with gradient text title
  • Teal accents for labels, bullets, and icons
  • Use for standard content slides
  • Title gradient: gray-800 to teal at 135 degrees
Slide Variant

Dark

  • Soft dark blue-gray background (#0d1117), not pure black
  • Electric-teal accents for labels, bullets, and icons
  • Title gradient: white to electric-teal at 135 degrees
  • Use for emphasis, key data, and closing slides
Slide Variant

Teal Hero

Solid teal background with white text. Use ONLY for title slides and section dividers. Never use for content-heavy slides.

Layout: Split Right

Content with Dark Sidebar

The main content area sits on a light background with standard padding. The dark sidebar panel on the right provides a contrasting zone for supporting details, key metrics, or callouts.

  • Two-column grid: flexible left, fixed 400px right
  • Sidebar uses --dark-bg with gradient text headings
  • Ideal for before/after, feature highlights, or KPIs

Key Takeaways

  • 40% reduction in development cost
  • 9 minutes vs. half a day for CVE remediation
  • 3-day turnaround on unsolicited proposals
  • 75% AI-enabled SDLC adoption target
Layout: Split Bottom

Content with Dark Stats Bar

The upper section holds the narrative content on a light background. The dark bar anchored to the bottom showcases key metrics with gradient number styling, creating visual weight and emphasis at the base of the slide.

Layout: Gradient Background

Gradient Background

  • Applied via inline style="background: linear-gradient(...)" on the slide element
  • This example: dark-bg → deep teal-black → dark-bg at 135 degrees
  • Electric-teal accents work the same as dark slides
  • Use for emphasis slides, section openers, or visual variety within dark sections
  • Any angle and color stop combination from the approved palette is valid

Chrome Elements

Navigation & Footer

  • Fixed breadcrumb bar at top with BAH logo (left) and clickable section navigation (center)
  • Glassmorphism effect (backdrop-filter blur) on both bars
  • Light/dark chrome switching based on current slide variant
  • Footer: secondary logo + BAH copyright + classification badge + counter
  • Classification badges: Entrusted (green), Internal (teal), Restricted (fuchsia)
